title: borrowed_skin_boyfriend
beats: My boyfriend (30M) has been beating my Minecraft parkour times for three weeks, and I just found out he doesn't own the game.
I (28F) stream casual parkour runs, nothing big, maybe 200 viewers a night.
He kept saying 'I got faster, babe, watch' and clearing my hardest maps on my second account.
Tonight I checked the account activity log because his 'skin' looked slightly off in a clip.
Turns out he's been having his coworker, someone who apparently used to speedrun competitively, remote into my PC and play as him.
For three weeks I told my chat MY boyfriend was getting good, and hyped him up to strangers.
I confronted him and he said 'it's not cheating, it's still on your account, chill out.'
I said impersonating someone else's skill under my roommate's identity to my own audience is exactly cheating.
He's furious I'm 'making this a big thing' and says I'm embarrassing him by even bringing it up.
His mom actually texted me saying I should be flattered he cared enough to get help.
I removed his access from my PC entirely and he hasn't spoken to me since.
